name: Team Operations
summary: Make team priorities, rhythms, ownership, and decisions legible.
firstAgentPrompt: Interview the operator about team purpose, people, ownership, operating rhythms, active priorities, and friction. Propose a minimal operating picture and avoid turning the repository into a project-management database.
additionalAgentPrompt: Read TEAM.md, PRIORITIES.md, RHYTHMS.md, DECISIONS.md, and AGENTS.md. Identify the team operation you can clarify or advance and preserve ownership in plain files.
